items.title: スマホ遠隔操作し商品だまし取った疑い 中国籍の2人逮捕 福岡

items.titleEn: Two Chinese citizens arrested in Fukuoka, suspected of using their phones remotely and smuggling goods.

items.title: 7月の熊本地震 災害関連死5人認定 直接死など含め死者は43人に
items.summary: ことし7月の熊本地震のあとに亡くなったあわせて5人が、災害関連死として10日、新たに認定され、この地震で災害関連死で亡くなったのは6人となりました。
items.titleEn: In July, there were 43 deaths, including the Kumbhumba earthquake, five deaths related to disasters, and direct deaths.
items.summaryEn: In addition to the deaths following the Kumbhumba earthquake in July, five people have been confirmed as disaster-related deaths for the past 10 days, and six people have died as a result of the earthquake.

items.titleEn: JR East "Walkthrough Change Tickets" will be rolled out in the spring of next year.
items.summaryEn: JR East Japan has announced that it will roll out the Walkthrough Pass, which can be passed without touching an IC card or inserting a ticket, at 40 stations in the capital region, including all stations of the Hokkaido line, starting next spring, 2028.
